name: Indeed Job Search MCP
description: Indeed-powered job search via MCP. Search listings, fetch job details, retrieve company intelligence (ratings, salaries, culture), and load resume context before searching.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search Indeed job listings by keyword, location, and type

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Fetch full job description and apply link by job ID

tools.name: get_company_data
tools.description: Retrieve company ratings, salaries, and culture data

tools.name: get_resume
tools.description: Load user resume context before searching or applying

notes: No API key required — provided via the Indeed MCP integration. Always call get_resume before search_jobs for personalized results.

changelog.notes: Initial Indeed MCP entry for career-ops pipeline.
